title: Axiom
description: One axiom record in the z-harness axiom store.

statement.description: Imperative behavioral rule; single sentence, non-empty, <=200 chars.

scope.description: Whether this axiom applies globally or only to the current project.

evidence.description: Cites events (not file:line). Each entry has run + (event_id or quote).

run.description: Run identifier that produced this evidence.

kind.description: Optional event kind tag (e.g. user_choice, user_override).

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the run that supports this axiom.

source_run.description: Run identifier that first proposed this axiom.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the axiom was created.

discipline.description: Optional free-form tag; compiler filter hint only.

applies_to.description: Optional routing-question entries this axiom answers. Each entry is "<question_id>:<value>" — the routing question id and the option value the axiom recommends, joined by a single colon (e.g. "workflow.slug_confirm:recommend_derived"). The <question_id> half matches [a-z0-9_.]+ (lowercase alnum, underscore, and dot — to match config.py's dotted QUESTION_IDS like workflow.slug_confirm); the <value> half is the recommended option value (non-empty, colon-free). At most one entry per <question_id>. Absence means free-form behavioral guidance (KERNEL.md only, never enters the resolver).

boundary_conditions.description: Optional list of conditions under which this axiom does not apply.

counterexamples.description: Optional list of counterexamples that bound the axiom's scope.

conflicts_with.description: Optional list of conflicting axiom ids (symmetric; checked by graph validation).

supersedes.description: Optional axiom id this record replaces, or null.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the axiom was approved. Set on approve.

review_after.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which this axiom should be reviewed. Lazily checked, never daemon.
